# Zarnay Yoga

> Yoga props for home practice, sewn and packed in a small workroom in Bend, Oregon, USA. Props only: no classes, no programs, no apparel. Ships within the USA.

## Props and prices (USD)
- Cork block (4 in or 3 in tall, 9 x 6 in face): $24
- Cotton strap (6 ft or 8 ft, steel D-rings): $16
- Cotton bolster (round or flat, 26 in long): $68
- Buckwheat floor cushion (14 in across, 5 in tall): $58
- Natural-rubber mat (72 x 24 in, 4 mm): $96
- Starter prop set (two blocks, one strap, one mat): $149
